name: regression_failures
description: Production failure cases reported 2026-10-25 (divorce-answer contamination, 96% confidence on a non-answer, false 'not covered'). Multi-turn sessions reproduce the in-session contamination; fresh sessions check the same questions without history. Assertions: forbidden_keywords must not appear in the answer; expected_document_patterns (regex, accent-folded lowercase) must match at least one evidence document_name; abstention_consistent requires confidence < 0.55 whenever the answer declares insufficiency; expect_answered requires no abstention and no low-confidence fallback.
